findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on Resource "*", giving this single identity full control over compute, storage, serverless execution, and monitoring. This permits privilege escalation (e.g. running arbitrary EC2 user data, modifying Lambda functions) and broad data access; any compromise of the identity means account-wide takeover of those services.

A static, non-rotating IAM access key is created for a user that carries the wildcard administrative policy above. The credential can be exfiltrated and used indefinitely without MFA or session scoping, making it a persistent account-wide credential.

findings.issue_category: IAM user instead of federated role
findings.description: Privileged deployment access is modelled as a long-lived IAM user with static keys rather than an assumable role with short-lived credentials, increasing credential lifetime and removing the session-scoping and audit benefits of role assumption.
